verdict.rationale: Unity offers web services such as Build Automation, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question here. The evidence shows no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec: every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path on docs.unity3d.com returned 404. The UPM registry's JSON responses, the CLI's structured output and the MCP server are different capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
